t: A boxed AI camera with its own microphones, speaker, and AI chip.
steps: Buy it from the Seeed Studio store or a maker shop such as OpenELab.
Plug in a 12 V power supply and a USB-C data cable to your computer.
Wait for the green light to stay solid.
Open a web browser and go to the address 192.168.42.1 to reach the built-in web page.
Watch the live view and try the ready-made object detection model.
Try the visual wake and offline speech demo from the Seeed wiki.
Use the HTTP API to pull results into your own script.
Install the C++ SDK on a Linux computer for deeper custom work.
